summary.intent: Bootstrap the release-please versioning system (phase 41) into a working state, fix an excessive changelog on PR #427, and validate the system with a small feature (expose API version on /health endpoint).
summary.outcome: Bootstrap tags created to trim the changelog, api-client packages aligned to API version (0.35.0), /health endpoint now returns version, OpenAPI spec updated with version field, and the post-merge release workflow was restructured to write release-as targets on the PR branch instead of pushing directly to main.

repo: release-please generates changelogs from the entire commit history if no prior tags exist — bootstrap tags must be created at the last known-good commit to cap history.
The release-please manifest lives at .release-please-manifest.json; 15 packages are tracked across apps/, packages/, and crates/.

HealthController is excluded from the NestJS OpenApiGeneratorModule because it requires a live TypeORM connection; the OpenAPI spec for /health is manually defined in apps/api/scripts/generate-openapi.ts around line 237-265.
The pr-release-preview.js script was not filtering merge commits, causing false bump labels to propagate to release-please PR #430 for packages that weren't actually changed.
Branch protection on main uses legacy rules (not rulesets), which lack per-actor bypass support — this blocked the post-merge workflow from pushing release-as config directly to main.
The api-client crate (crates/api-client) and JS package (packages/api-client) were intentionally version-aligned to the API (apps/api) since they are tightly coupled.
openapi.json in packages/api-client requires a jsonpath extra-file entry in release-please-config.json (not a plain path) to bump the nested info.version field.

code.finding: Controllers list for OpenApiGeneratorModule explicitly excludes HealthController; health spec is hand-authored further down (~line 237-265).
Manual health endpoint schema — needed to add version, error, details, and required fields here to match actual response shape.
OpenAPI version was hardcoded as 0.1.0; changed to read from npm_package_version with a fallback to reading package.json directly via require('fs') and join(__dirname, '..', 'package.json').
New shared module created to deduplicate version-reading logic used by both main.ts and health.controller.ts. Exports API_VERSION constant.
Merge commits (commits with 2+ parents) were not filtered before conventional commit parsing, causing false bump labels for all packages on PRs that included a merge commit.

workflow: When release-please has never run before, create bootstrap tags at the baseline commit for all packages in the manifest before first workflow run.
Conventional commit scope matters for release-please: using fix: instead of chore: triggers unnecessary patch version bumps across dependent packages.
The fix: commit type should be avoided for CI/tooling-only changes; use chore(ci): to prevent release-please from generating version bumps.
GitHub Actions GITHUB_TOKEN pushes do not trigger new workflow runs (built-in recursion prevention), making it safe to commit back to the PR branch from within a workflow.

When the post-merge release job needs to write to main but branch protection blocks it, the cleanest solution is to move that logic into the PR preview step so the changes land on main via the normal PR merge.
Squash merges propagate the squash commit message to release-please, so the commit type/scope must accurately reflect all changed packages.

friction: Branch protection legacy rules lack per-actor bypass, blocking the post-merge workflow from pushing to main — required a full workflow architecture change.
Cargo.lock regeneration pulled in unrelated dependency updates when running cargo update, requiring manual selective update of only the workspace crate.
git index.lock file left behind by a previous process blocked git switch, requiring manual removal.
The executor agent was interrupted mid-run during the quick task, requiring manual reimplementation of the plan with the correct feat(api): commit scope.
Auto-merge showed as enabled by the user but gh pr view reported autoMergeRequest as null, causing confusion about merge status.
The pr-release-preview workflow checking out only the merge ref (not the PR branch head) required restructuring to support committing back to the PR branch.
open_items: Re-enable 'Do not allow bypassing required pull requests' on main branch protection now that the post-merge push to main is no longer needed.
The post-merge release workflow and script were deleted — verify the release-as injection via PR preview works end-to-end on the next real PR merge.
The monotonic/major.minor versioning decision for web and desktop apps from phase 41 discussion log was deferred — currently using semver for all packages.
openapi.json formatting inconsistency (compact vs expanded arrays) introduced during the npm_package_version fix — may resurface on future api:generate runs.
Bootstrap tags still needed for any packages that did not have pre-existing tags after phase 41 (verify all 15 are present on origin).
